steps.message:
Okay, the Maven download takes a very long time because it is resolving and downloading hundreds of AWS SDK internal modules from central.
Wait! Let's check if we can run Maven with `-o` (offline mode) if we already downloaded most of the artifacts, or see if we can compile only the modules we changed!
Let's see what modules we've modified:
1. `apm-agent-core`
2. `apm-kafka-base-plugin` (under `apm-agent-plugins/apm-kafka-plugin/apm-kafka-base-plugin`)
3. `apm-apache-httpclient-plugin` (under `apm-agent-plugins/apm-apache-httpclient-plugin`)
4. `apm-es-restclient-plugin-common` (under `apm-agent-plugins/apm-es-restclient-plugin/apm-es-restclient-plugin-common`)
5. `apm-servlet-plugin` (under `apm-agent-plugins/apm-servlet-plugin`)

Wait! Can we compile only these specific modules using `-pl`?
E.g., `mvn compile -pl apm-agent-core,apm-agent-plugins/apm-kafka-plugin/apm-kafka-base-plugin,apm-agent-plugins/apm-apache-httpclient-plugin,apm-agent-plugins/apm-es-restclient-plugin/apm-es-restclient-plugin-common,apm-agent-plugins/apm-servlet-plugin -am -DskipTests`?
Yes! That would ONLY download dependencies for these modules and compile them! This is much faster and will not time out downloading thousands of unrelated jars (like AWS, Grails, etc.).
Let's explain modifying commands (though compiling is relatively safe) and run this targeted compilation.
